Review guidance: Confirm the actual business model, profile ownership, and the access needed for the agreed review.

Check: Check business details against the business’s records
Review guidance: Review the business name, categories, hours, contact details, and linked website. Note the source of each correction.
Compare published service coverage and location statements with where the team actually works.
Check how genuine customers can leave feedback and how the business responds. Record observed gaps, not a guessed review target.

Check: Map accepted services to useful pages
Review guidance: List work actually offered. Separate customer tasks that need distinct explanations; combine close wording variants.
Check whether the page explains coverage, assessment or consultation, and what happens after contact.

Check: Connect relevant project and qualification evidence
Review guidance: Identify accurate project descriptions, approved photographs, and credentials that support the service being offered.
Compare pages answering the same customer task. Record what each contributes before recommending consolidation.

Check: Confirm search access for priority URLs
Review guidance: Record status codes, indexing directives, canonical URLs, and available Search Console inspection evidence.

Check: Connect service overviews, projects, and contact routes
Review guidance: Follow crawlable links from the main service overview to the relevant page and its next step.

Check: Inspect the mobile reading and contact experience
Review guidance: Check legibility, navigation, horizontal overflow, phone links, and form controls at an actual phone width.
Check validation, delivery configuration, success and error feedback, and who receives the inquiry. Agree any test submission first.
Agree service requested, coverage, job fit, and how duplicate inquiries will be handled.
Distinguish phone clicks, answered calls, appointments, and completed work using records the team can supply.
Note date range, market, device, page and query filters, brand treatment, and tracking changes where relevant.

Check: Assign the next action and its acceptance check
Review guidance: Give each agreed improvement an owner and an observable completion check. Separate implementation completion from later performance.
